title: Characterization of layered polynomial size
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ belongs to the class of languages with polynomial-size layered circuits using the specified standard gate operations if and only if there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ and such a circuit family recognizing exactly $L$ whose size on inputs of length $n$ is at most $a(n+1)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
